gates.requirement: All declared dimensions have positive and adversarial examples; each scenario has a minimal pair and at least one cross-document dependency. Human review confirms intended discrimination.
Two domain annotators independently label first-pass packets; pre-adjudication agreement and unresolved items are published.
Known semantic defects and faithful paraphrases are independently adjudicated; report detection and false-alarm rates without conflating parsing and semantic judgments.
External custodian selects genuinely separate source organisations/process families unseen by engineering. This authored bank cannot satisfy the gate.

Choose a practically meaningful paired difference and uncertainty target before scoring. Estimate family-level variance in a separate feasibility sample, then preregister family count and comparison plan. Six scenarios and 48 probes are coverage targets, not a sufficient statistical sample.
Freeze corpus, eligible tasks, supported model settings, endpoint/runtime, prompt and harness versions, resource bounds, failure attribution and retry policy before inference.

promotion_rule: No numerical quality/cost/time ranking from this bank. No new model expansion until labels, coverage and campaign design are reviewed; independent qualification needs all relevant external gates.
